name: classnotes-json-api
description: JSON Server backend for ClassNotes demos and mobile testing

scripts.start: sh -c 'mkdir -p public; DB_PATH=db.json; if [ -d /data ]; then test -f /data/db.json || cp db.json /data/db.json; DB_PATH=/data/db.json; fi; json-server "$DB_PATH" --host 0.0.0.0 --port ${PORT:-3001}'
